title: The wrong turn
prompt: This square goes wrong at the third corner: one of the turns is a right turn. Change it to a left turn so all four turns match.
starter:
func solve():
	move_forward(40)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(40)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(40)
	turn_right()
	move_forward(40)
	turn_left()
hints: Read the calls from top to bottom and find the one that differs.

docs.name: move_forward(distance)
docs.what: Drives the turtle forward that many pixels, drawing a line. Takes one number; returns nothing.

docs.name: turn_left()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the left. Give it a number to turn by a different angle.

solution:
func solve():
	move_forward(40)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(40)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(40)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(40)
	turn_left()
